text: local I=require("components/inventory") I.OrigGNAS=I.OrigGNAS or I.GetNextAvailableSlot I.GetNextAvailableSlot=function(self,item) if item and item.components and item.components.equippable and not item.components.stackable then for k=self.maxslots,1,-1 do if self.itemslots[k]==nil and (not self.CanTakeItemInSlot or self:CanTakeItemInSlot(item,k)) then return k,self.itemslots end end end return I.OrigGNAS(self,item) end --M

text: local IB,Tx,P,S=require("widgets/imagebutton"),require("widgets/text"),ThePlayer,1.25 local c=P.HUD.controls local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local k=c:GetScale().x local w=c:GetWorldPosition() local y=(c.inv.inv[1]:GetWorldPosition().y-34-w.y)/k local x=(W-0.175*H-w.x)/k local g=S*40+5 for _,v in ipairs(P._rot or {}) do v:Kill() end P._rot={} local function T(d) pcall(function() TheCamera:SetHeadingTarget(TheCamera:GetHeadingTarget()+d*45) end) end local function R(d,l,px) local b=c:AddChild(IB("images/hud.xml","equip_slot.tex","equip_slot.tex","equip_slot.tex")) b:SetPosition(px,y) b:SetScale(S) b.image:SetTint(1,1,1,0.5) b:AddChild(Tx(NUMBERFONT,44,l)) local t local o=b.OnControl b.OnControl=function(s,n,dn) if n==CONTROL_ACCEPT or n==CONTROL_PRIMARY then if t then t:Cancel() t=nil end if dn then T(d) t=b.inst:DoPeriodicTask(0.4,function() T(d) end) end return true end return o and o(s,n,dn) end table.insert(P._rot,b) end R(1,"<",x-g) R(-1,">",x+g) --M

text: local IB=require("widgets/imagebutton") local Im=require("widgets/image") local P=ThePlayer local V=P.replica.inventory local X,Y=420,-280 local R=P._rot and P._rot[1] if P._qb then P._qb:Kill() end local function pick() local it=V:GetItems() for i=V:GetNumSlots(),1,-1 do local x=it[i] if x and x.replica.equippable then return x end end end local b=P.HUD.controls:AddChild(IB("images/hud.xml","equip_slot.tex","equip_slot.tex","equip_slot.tex")) b:SetPosition(X,Y) b:SetScale(R and R:GetScale().x or 1.25) b.image:SetTint(1,1,1,0.5) local ic=b:AddChild(Im("images/hud.xml","equip_slot.tex")) ic:SetClickable(false) ic:Hide() b.inst:DoPeriodicTask(0.25,function() pcall(function() local x=pick() if x then local i=x.replica.inventoryitem ic:SetTexture(i:GetAtlas(),i:GetImage()) ic:Show() else ic:Hide() end end) end) b:SetOnClick(function() local x=pick() if x then V:UseItemFromInvTile(x) end end) P._qb=b --M

text: MWK={"HOUNDS","WORMS","DEERCLOPS","BEARGER","ANTLION"} local function red(m) if not pcall(function() ChatHistory:AddToHistory(ChatTypes.SystemMessage,nil,nil,nil,m,{1,0.2,0.2,1},nil,nil,true) end) then Networking_SystemMessage(m) end end local function warn(k) for _,w in ipairs(MWK) do if k:find(w) then return true end end end local T=require("components/talker") T.OrigSay=T.OrigSay or T.Say T.Say=function(self,s,...) pcall(function() if self.inst==ThePlayer and type(s)=="string" then for _,n in ipairs({string.upper(self.inst.prefab),"GENERIC"}) do for k,v in pairs(STRINGS.CHARACTERS[n] or {}) do if type(k)=="string" and warn(k) and (v==s or type(v)=="table" and table.contains(v,s)) then red(self.inst:GetDisplayName()..": "..s) return end end end end end) return T.OrigSay(self,s,...) end --M

text: MW_MODE=false function MW_Dest(P,inv,c,it) local ov=inv:GetOverflowContainer() local ovi=ov and ov.inst local pot,best,bs for k in pairs(inv:GetOpenContainers()) do local r=k.replica.container if r and k~=P and k~=ovi and not (r.IsReadOnlyContainer and r:IsReadOnlyContainer()) then if k.prefab:find("cookpot") then pot=k elseif r:CanTakeItemInSlot(it) then local sc=(k.prefab=="icebox" or k.prefab=="saltbox") and 2 or 1 for _,v in pairs(r:GetItems()) do if v.prefab==it.prefab then sc=3 end end if not bs or sc>bs then best,bs=k,sc end end end end if MW_MODE=="top" then if c.inst==pot then return P,false end if pot and pot.replica.container:CanTakeItemInSlot(it) then return pot,true end return nil end if c==inv or c==ov then return best,false end return P,false end --M
label: 7.1 (Local) Single tap toggle to move items from and to crockpot/storage boxes (This mod cmd is 5 commands long, run in proper order)

text: function MW_Move(s) local P=ThePlayer local inv=P.replica.inventory local c,n=s.container,s.num local it=c:GetItemInSlot(n) if not it then return end local d,one=MW_Dest(P,inv,c,it) if not d or d==c.inst then TheFocalPoint.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/HUD/click_negative") return end local dm=P.HUD.controls.inv:GetDropMode() local st=it.replica.stackable local z=st and st:StackSize() or 1 if one or dm==DROP_MODES.ONE then c:MoveItemFromCountOfSlot(n,d,1) elseif dm==DROP_MODES.HALF then c:MoveItemFromCountOfSlot(n,d,math.max(1,math.floor(z/2))) else c:MoveItemFromAllOfSlot(n,d) end TheFocalPoint.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/HUD/click_object") end --M
label: 7.2 (Local) Single tap toggle to move items from and to crockpot/storage boxes (2/5)

text: function MW_Open(m) local P=ThePlayer local inv=P.replica.inventory local ov=inv:GetOverflowContainer() local ovi=ov and ov.inst for k in pairs(inv:GetOpenContainers()) do if k~=P and k~=ovi and k.replica.container and (k.prefab:find("cookpot")~=nil)==(m=="top") then return true end end return false end local I=require("widgets/invslot") I.OrigTE=I.OrigTE or I.OnTouchEnd I.OrigDT=I.OrigDT or I.OnDoubleTap I.OnTouchEnd=function(s,id,x,y) if MW_MODE and s.touchID==id and s.tile and s.tile.item and ThePlayer.replica.inventory:GetActiveItem()==nil then s.touchID=nil local ok,e=pcall(MW_Move,s) if not ok then Networking_SystemMessage("MW move: "..tostring(e)) end return end return I.OrigTE(s,id,x,y) end I.OnDoubleTap=function(s,x,y) if MW_MODE then return true end return I.OrigDT(s,x,y) end --M
label: 7.3 (Local) Single tap toggle to move items from and to crockpot/storage boxes (3/5)

text: function MW_Tint() for _,v in ipairs(ThePlayer._mw or {}) do v.image:SetTint(1,1,1,v.m==MW_MODE and 1 or 0.5) end end function MW_Watch() local P=ThePlayer if MW_MODE then if MW_Open(MW_MODE) then P._sn=true elseif P._sn then MW_MODE=false MW_Tint() end end end --M
label: 7.4 (Local) Single tap toggle to move items from and to crockpot/storage boxes (4/5)

text: local IB,Tx,P=require("widgets/imagebutton"),require("widgets/text"),ThePlayer local c=P.HUD.controls local _,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local k=c:GetScale().x local w=c:GetWorldPosition() local q=c.inv.drop_mode_button:GetWorldPosition() local S=P._rot and P._rot[1] and P._rot[1]:GetScale().x or 1.25 for _,v in ipairs(P._mw or {}) do v:Kill() end P._mw={} local function mk(l,m,off) local b=c:AddChild(IB("images/hud.xml","equip_slot.tex","equip_slot.tex","equip_slot.tex")) b:SetPosition((q.x-off*H-w.x)/k,(q.y-w.y)/k) b:SetScale(S) b.image:SetTint(1,1,1,0.5) b:AddChild(Tx(NUMBERFONT,34,l)) b.m=m b:SetOnClick(function() MW_MODE=(MW_MODE~=m) and m or false P._sn=false MW_Tint() end) table.insert(P._mw,b) end mk("BOX","bottom",0.13) mk("POT","top",0.24) P._mw[1].inst:DoPeriodicTask(0.5,function() pcall(MW_Watch) end) --M
